definition: 2014년 1~12월 국적별·월별 입국비율에 따라 respondent weight 부여
methodology: 전체 보고서의 모든 결과에 가중치 적용; 국가별/월별 입국비율과 동일 셀 유효표본수를 이용해 wt 산출
limitations: User's Guide evidence verifies country×month construction only; it does not establish additional calibration/nonresponse adjustment, trimming/capping, zero-cell handling, exact arrival-population exclusions, or respondent-level missing rules
formula: wt = (국가별/월별 입국비율 × 총 조사 유효표본수) / 국가별/월별 유효표본수
population_control: 국가별/월별 입국비율 (exact source population/exclusion rules not independently extracted)
missing_unknown_fields: exact arrival-population exclusions; source statistic for entry ratios; zero-cell handling; nonresponse adjustment; trimming/capping; calibration tolerance; respondent-level missing rules; attachment-level license
